# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 6 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 6:4 — place my seat vs. set my throne

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "place my seat above the stars" | Literal ponam sedem meam — 'seat' |
| LOGOS | "set my throne above the stars" | Interprets sedes as throne — more regal |
| PNEUMA | "set my throne above the stars" | Same as LOGOS |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** LOGOS/PNEUMA: 'set my throne.' The Latin sedes can mean seat or throne. In this context of cosmic rebellion echoing Isaiah 14:13, 'throne' is more appropriate. Adopted LOGOS.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.
